lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy6Cr2Mo2 (reduced formula Dy3CrMo) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 10 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr and Mo each adopt an octahedral environment with six Dy neighbors, while Dy is surrounded by three Cr and three Mo neighbors. The Cr and Mo octahedra share corners with one another, and face-sharing is observed between Dy-centered 6-vertex coordination polyhedra and both Cr and Mo octahedra. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites.
